mission.name: Crossing - target broad on port bow (own-ship stand-on)
mission.description:
Target is broad on own-ship's port bow (~60 deg relative to port). The target does not give way, so own-ship must hold course/speed under Rule 17(a)(i) and only act under Rule 17(a)(ii)/(b) if the target clearly fails to act and collision becomes otherwise unavoidable.

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: Imazu problem 4 samples a port crossing at only one bearing (~-68 deg). This mission is the broad-bearing (~-60 deg) point of a 2-point port sweep (with UM07) testing stand-on behaviour across the bearing range.

Rescaled 2026-09-24 to Imazu scale (12 kt own-ship, 6 NM/30 min construction) -- the original small-craft scale (own speed ~2.5 m/s, 600-1100 m target range) left no geometric margin for a 30 deg-per-command turn to open the 500 m safe distance before impact (e.g. UM04 needed >=90 deg on the very first command). Bearings/ranges below are a byproduct of preserving each target's original heading + speed ratio under this construction, not independently chosen.
pass_criteria: Own-ship holds course and speed for a meaningful initial period (does not manoeuvre prematurely).
If the target never gives way, own-ship eventually takes late avoiding action under Rule 17(b) rather than colliding.
Minimum CPA stays above the safe-distance threshold.
